outcome: Cervical elastography parameters (elasticity contrast index (ECI), internal os strain mean level (IOS), external os strain mean level (EOS), IOS/EOS strain mean ratio, strain mean level, and hardness ratio)
cohort: Nulliparous women at 36 weeks of gestation eligible for vaginal delivery
finding: Cervical elastography parameters, measured using the E-Cervix system, showed significant differences between women with spontaneous labor and those who underwent labor induction.
